name: Special Delivery for Gaxim
summary: In Stonetalon, Gaxim Rustfizzle awaits a scroll from Stormwind. Collin Mauren provides the Scroll of Messaging, whose arcane power is needed to build a remote explosive against the Venture Company's deforestation.

sections.title: Arcane Deliveries
sections.body: Gaxim Rustfizzle seeks to hinder the Venture Company's destructive work in the Stonetalon Mountains. He has made an explosive compound called NG-5, but lacks a reliable way to set it off from afar. Rather than use crude fuses, Gaxim enlisted help across the Great Sea. He contacted Collin Mauren in Stormwind's Mage Quarter to obtain an enchanted Scroll of Messaging.

sections.title: A Remote Distraction
sections.body: Gaxim Rustfizzle plans to bind the Scroll of Messaging's magic to his unstable NG-5 mixture. Its power to carry messages across long distances can trigger the explosive from afar. Gaxim means to create a devastating distraction, giving operatives a chance to slip into the Venture Company compound unseen.

faq.q: What is the Scroll of Messaging used for?
faq.answer: The Scroll of Messaging carries words across long distances, but Gaxim Rustfizzle can bind its magic to NG-5 as a remote trigger. That lets him set off explosives from a safe distance.
Collin Mauren is an Alliance wizard in Stormwind City's Mage Quarter. He helps with arcane matters and crafts the enchanted scroll Gaxim needs in Stonetalon.

faq.q: Why is Gaxim Rustfizzle sabotaging the Venture Company?
faq.answer: The Venture Company is ruthlessly clear-cutting the Stonetalon Mountains' pristine forests. Gaxim aims to slow the deforestation by causing chaos, destroying their operations, and stealing their engineering plans and correspondence.

faq.q: Where does this delivery take the adventurer?
faq.answer: The delivery takes you from Stormwind City across the sea to the Alliance camp in the crags of the Stonetalon Mountains on Kalimdor.

faq.q: What happens after the scroll is delivered?
faq.answer: With the scroll and NG-5 in hand, Gaxim prepares a remote explosive distraction. It clears the way for an operative to enter the Windshear Crag operations and recover logging letters and schematics.

angles.text: Gaxim's scheme joins gnomish engineering with wizardry, pairing volatile NG-5 explosives with arcane triggers.
Collin Mauren's craft shows how clever tinkerers can turn a simple parchment enchantment into a working arcane relay.
As an Alliance member, you see the ties between Stormwind and remote outposts resisting industrial exploitation in Kalimdor.
